description:
Start watching a property in a covered county for `email`. `address`: street address with house number and
        city (e.g. '1702 Ellsworth St, Philadelphia'); `state`: two-letter code; `county`: county or borough
        ('Philadelphia', 'Cook', 'Brooklyn'). Returns the watch and, for a new email, `access_key` + `dashboard_url`:
        the ONLY key to that watch list (no password exists), shown once; give it to the user and tell them to keep it
        private. The first check runs within minutes (status 'pending' until the parcel is resolved). An email that
        already has a watch list gets an error: its owner adds properties from their own list. Free during the launch
        period, with a per-email cap.
name: create_property_watch
